title: Sensor test setup
summary: A desk full of sensors and actuators around one ESP32-C5: potentiometer, distance, pressure, time-of-flight, load cell, servos and a DC motor with encoder. Watch each part live in the browser, and connect sensors to actuators with the input-output matrix.
hardware: MCP3008 8-channel ADC: potentiometer, MH sensor module
TCA9548 I2C multiplexer + 2x WF100DPZ pressure sensor
HX711 load cell amplifier + load cell
L298N motor driver + DC gear motor with encoder
